The '''Flashpoint system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Flashpoint (planet)|planet of the same name]] which orbited extremely closely to [[Flashpoint (star)|its star]].
